newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Observatory to screen moon eclipse on Internet.
newsitem.headline: Observatory to screen moon eclipse on Internet.

text.p: A Belgian observatory said on Friday it would be showing a partial eclipse of the moon early on Monday morning live on its http://www.ping.be/Mira Website.

Claiming a world first for screening a solar eclipse live on the Net on October 12, the MIRA observatory in Grimbergen said that weather permitting it would use a special video camera to digitalise and broadcast the event between 0258 and 0439 GMT.
MIRA said its aim was to popularise astronomy.
